blocks: assigning an agent that is missing, inactive, unminted/ambiguous, or lacks member on the task squad
threat: assigning work to an agent outside the squad's authority (cross-squad execution)

blocks: assigning a human member who is missing, inactive, or lacks member on the task squad
threat: putting work under a named human who cannot see the board (fake provenance/invisibility)

blocks: a creator who is also the assignee naming the gate at create
threat: self-close loop: worker picks its own reviewer
duplicates: NOT mirrored in task_update (an assignee may set gate_owner on its own open/in_progress task when none is set)

blocks: P1 task with no project_id/parent_task_id and no '[owner: @x, ttl: Nd]' escape hatch in body
threat: unowned urgent work with no review deadline

blocks: illegal status moves: open->in_progress only; in_progress->review|blocked|done; approved->done; rejected->in_progress|done; blocked->in_progress; done terminal; review exits only by verdict
threat: state forging around the gate (the review/approved/done edges); other edges are workflow friction

bar.current: fixed matrix (open cannot go to done/blocked; blocked cannot go to open; no reopen of done)
bar.onboarding: allow open->done and open->blocked for UNGATED tasks; blocked->open

blocks: an agent-assigned task entering review, or going ungated straight to done, without 'Artifact: <path>' + 'SHA256: <64-hex>' in tasks.result
threat: fabricated agent completion evidence accepted as real
